title: Tensor homology coordinates over a field
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], let $A,B$ be integer-indexed cochain complexes of $k$-vector spaces, and set $T=\operatorname{Tot}(A\otimes_k B)$ with direct-sum terms and differential $d_A\otimes 1+(-1)^p1\otimes d_B$. For every integer $n$ there exists a linear map $r:H^n(T)\to\bigoplus_{p+q=n}H^p(A)\otimes_k H^q(B)$ such that, for any $a\in Z^p(A)$, $b\in Z^q(B)$ with $p+q=n$ and any total cycle $z$ whose inclusion is the summand tensor $a\otimes b$, $r([z])$ is the summand tensor $[a]\otimes[b]$. No boundedness assumption is needed.

proof.text: Extend each cycles-to-homology quotient to the full term using a linear left inverse of the injective cycles inclusion. On cycles the extension is the quotient; on each incoming differential it is zero by toCycles_comp_homologyπ.

Tensor the extensions in each bidegree, then compose with the corresponding direct-sum inclusion. mapBifunctorDesc assembles a morphism t from the degree-n total term to the sum of tensor homology modules. The two terms of the total differential are killed by the first and second extension respectively; verify on pure tensors using mapBifunctor.hom_ext and tensor_ext.

Restrict t to total cycles and descend to homology using ShortComplex.descHomology and the vanishing on boundaries. The equation π_descHomology and the summand equation ι_mapBifunctorDesc show that this linear map sends a product cycle class to its prescribed direct-sum tensor class.

lean.statement:
theorem tensor_homology_coordinates {k : Type u} [Field k]
    (A B : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} k) ℤ) (n : ℤ) :
    ∃ r : (mapBifunctor A B (curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{u} k))
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).homology n →ₗ[k]
        (⨁ s : {pq : ℤ × ℤ // pq.1 + pq.2 = n},
          (A.homology s.1.1) ⊗[k] (B.homology s.1.2)),
      ∀ (s : {pq : ℤ × ℤ // pq.1 + pq.2 = n})
        (a : A.cycles s.1.1) (b : B.cycles s.1.2)
        (z : (mapBifunctor A B (curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{u} k))
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).cycles n),
        (mapBifunctor A B (curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{u} k))
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).iCycles n z =
          ιMapBifunctor A B (curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{u} k)) (ComplexShape.up ℤ)
            s.1.1 s.1.2 n s.2
            ((A.iCycles s.1.1 a) ⊗ₜ[k] (B.iCycles s.1.2 b)) →
        r ((mapBifunctor A B (curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{u} k))
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).homologyπ n z) =
          DirectSum.lof k _ _ s
            ((A.homologyπ s.1.1 a) ⊗ₜ[k] (B.homologyπ s.1.2 b))
